findings.description: Although there is no direct OS command execution in the code, the filename provided to the Logger constructor could potentially be manipulated to perform unintended actions if the code were to be extended to execute commands based on file content.
The logger does not log errors related to file operations, which could lead to issues being undetected.
Similar to CWE-78, although not directly applicable here, it's good practice to ensure that any user-provided input is sanitized.
The code does not validate the input filename, which could lead to issues if the filename is invalid or malicious.
